_how_to_edit: Scripted demo scenarios. Each button drives the car through these steps in order, so the backend sees the car approach the hazard (early warning) before it happens (critical alert).
The browser simulator and the backend tests (backend/scenarios.py) both run this file, so edit it here only. Reload the simulator page after editing.
Each step needs a 'label' and a duration: 'seconds', or 'until' ({"speed_kph_at_least": N} or {"speed_kph_at_most": N}) plus 'max_s' as a safety limit.

Driving (pick one): 'throttle'/'brake' (0-1), 'hold_speed_kph', 'brake_use' or 'throttle_use' (0-1 share of the tires' grip limit right now, so worn tires are driven just as close to their limit as new ones). Optional 'steer' (-1 left .. 1 right).
Optional 'cue' drawn in the car view: braking_boards, hairpin, corner_right, debris. Optional 'event' at the end of the step: {"puncture": "FL"|"FR"|"RL"|"RR"|"selected"}.
Grip use: about 0.9 and above shows as slip near the limit (a 'near lock-up' / 'near wheelspin' warning); above 1.0 the tire lets go.

lockup.label: Lock-up
lockup.button: Braking later and later → front lock-up

steps.label: Build speed on the main straight
Braking zone 2 of 3: braking later, right at the limit
Braking zone 3 of 3: far too late, stamping on the brakes

wheelspin.label: Wheelspin
wheelspin.button: Harder and harder exits → rear wheelspin

steps.label: Brake for the next, slower hairpin
Hairpin exit 2 of 3: aggressive throttle, right at the limit
Hairpin exit 3 of 3: full throttle from almost a standstill

corner.label: Overheating
corner.button: Fast corners, then a long one → overheating

steps.label: Fast right-handers: outside tires heating up
Long, tight right-hander: tires pushed past the limit

puncture.label: Slow puncture
puncture.button: Debris on the racing line → slow puncture
